rationale: Both reviews are well-evidenced and precise, and both independently surface the same major, real bug (ARDiffusionModelRunner.execute_model not updated for the new diffusion_kv_metadata param) that isn't in the ground truth. But the ground truth's substantive human concerns are architectural: consolidate duplicate validation/exception types across layers (asukaqaq-s), and enforce DTO-local invariants on the new metadata contracts (hsliuustc0106's P1 items on the old stage_kv/interface.py). Y directly engages both threads — collapsing overlapping identity checks, and a detailed proposal to restore invariants (uniqueness, referential integrity, frozen dataclasses) on the new DiffusionKVMetadata DTOs that the old StageKV DTOs enforced — while X's findings skew toward narrower test-coverage and docstring nitpicks that don't reach that architectural substance. Neither review has a LATENT GAP CHECK section, so gap_hit is false for both.
